## func FirstSkill

```go
func FirstSkill(t *testing.T) (string, []byte)
```

FirstSkill returns the path and content of the first embedded skill. It is shared between cmd/takt\-ai and takt/tui/runtime test suites to avoid duplicating the same loader in two packages.
